text: まいにち　この　じかんには　べんとうを　もって　くるのに…

structure.jp: まいにち　この　じかんには
べんとうを　もって　くるのに…
structure.en: she brings my lunch, and yet...

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', and left hanging at the end it shows worry or disappointment that things are different this time. くるのに = 'even though she comes...'

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる means doing it and coming here. もってくる = 'bring', literally 'hold and come'.
